features.title: Visual theme picker: color swatches + pickers, in-font font menus, corner preview boxes
features.notes: Colors as swatch boxes open by default with color picker + hex entry (Colors above Corners); font menus render each option in its own white-text font (expanded curated Google Fonts library); corners as 3 preview boxes in different colors. app/admin/ThemePicker.tsx. Live.

features.title: Experience list on Profile tab (add-one-at-a-time, animated boxes)
features.notes: ExperienceEditor: role/company/dates/description entries added one at a time, each box animates in like a chat message. Stored on Profile.experience (JSON) and fed into the chatbot system prompt. Live.

features.title: Retrieval engine v1: chunk/entity/edge tables, hybrid retrieval + one-hop graph expansion, persona-core prompt
features.notes: Sources are chunked+embedded+entity-extracted inline at ingest (lib/retrieval/*); chat builds persona-core prompt + retrieved context for the visitor's question (buildSystemPrompt(query)). Embeddings: VOYAGE_API_KEY/OPENAI_API_KEY if set, else local hashed n-grams; hybrid BM25+cosine with EntityEdge one-hop expansion. Backfill: npx tsx scripts/reindex.ts. Proof: docs/features/retrieval-engine-v1/proof.ts (green); gate PASS; verified live in browser.

features.title: Graph tab: see and fix the extracted entity/relation graph
features.notes: Admin dashboard 'Graph' tab (app/admin/GraphPanel.tsx) over lib/retrieval/graph.ts: index-health stats (sources/chunks/entities/relations/orphans, plus warnings for missing embeddings and a mixed-embedding-model index), every entity with mention count + source titles + edge count, orphans flagged, and every relation. Fixes: rename/retype an entity (renaming onto an existing name MERGES them — mentions move, edges rewire, duplicates collapse, self-loops drop), delete entity, delete relation, add relation. Server actions are thin auth wrappers so the logic stays testable. Proof: docs/features/knowledge-graph-admin/proof.ts (28 assertions green); gate PASS. Not yet visually clicked through (admin login required).
features.next: Phase 2 continues: persona-aware entity ontology in lib/retrieval/entities.ts + persona-biased ranking.

features.title: Index every admin surface into one knowledge graph (profile, persona, projects, photos, knowledge, approved answers)
features.notes: Chunk gains originKind/originId/originLabel and sourceId becomes nullable, so the index is origin-agnostic (lib/retrieval/indexer.ts indexOrigin/dropOrigin). lib/retrieval/origins.ts turns each surface into indexable text and is triggered inline by the admin saves (saveProfile/uploadResume, savePersona, add/update/deleteProject, upload/update/deletePhoto, saveChatFeedback, deleteChatSession) — best-effort, never fails a save. ACTIVITY IS APPROVAL-GATED: only assistant answers rated up are indexed, because visitor-typed chat is untrusted input and would otherwise poison the KB. Prompt slimmed: bio/experience/project blurbs/photo descriptions are now retrieved, while identity, contact, persona, project id index and A2UI rules stay always-on. Graph tab shows an 'Indexed from' per-origin breakdown. Proof: docs/features/universal-knowledge-index/proof.ts (25 assertions green); prior three proofs still green; gate PASS.
features.next: Deploy + run `npx tsx scripts/reindex.ts --all` on production: existing prod chunks predate the origin columns and carry empty originId/originLabel until reindexed.

features.title: Import all projects from a GitHub profile link
features.notes: Projects tab 'Import from GitHub': paste a profile URL, fetches public non-fork repos via GitHub API (lib/github.ts), creates a Project per repo (name, description->blurb, html_url->githubUrl, homepage->liveUrl), most-starred first, capped at 12, skips already-imported (deduped by githubUrl). Verified live against a real profile. Live.

features.title: Persona sections: high-fidelity persona + agent behaviors, one text box per section; Persona and Theme split into two tabs
features.notes: lib/persona.ts is the catalogue (9 persona sections + 12 agent-behavior sections, each with label/hint/rows); the admin form, savePersona, and the chat prompt all iterate it. Stored as JSON in Profile.personaSections. Admin 'Persona & Theme' split into 'Persona' (tagline + 21 textareas, one form) and 'Theme' (aesthetic + ThemePicker, saveTheme). buildSystemPrompt renders only filled sections (grouped, labeled); retired VOICE & WORLDVIEW / Overview / Values lines. Legacy persona/overview/values/tone columns kept unused pending the ingestion pass. Proof: docs/features/persona-sections/proof.ts (green); verified live in browser (save + reload round-trip).
features.next: Ingestion: fill sections from an uploaded document / existing knowledge, incl. mapping the legacy persona columns.
